result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked visually.

The screen is a 1280px `#component` on the pale blue Sand background. The "New request" heading sits on the left. The form card is on the right and spans 8 of the 12 columns. It has the Title, Description, Priority, Assignee and Due date fields in that order, with Priority, Assignee and Due date sharing one row. Cancel (quiet) and Create Request (ink pill) are at the bottom right. All the copy is exactly as you gave it.

I followed `DESIGN.md` for the colors, type sizes, spacing, radii and letter-spacing. I also kept to its button, input, hover and reduced-motion rules.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo are named in the CSS, but the brief says no other assets, so I didn't load them. Without them installed, the browser falls back to a system sans-serif.
- **Input borders:** They use Muted `#55656A` instead of the thinner Accent line `#9CC3EA`, because the lighter color is too faint against white to see.
- **Default selections:** Priority starts on Medium and Assignee on Maya Chen, since the brief doesn't give placeholder text.
